author: Kuokka77
description:
"Modulator" demo OST by Jazz. The demo (by Konsumer) ranked 1st at RSYNC 2026 fantasy computer compo - PICO-8.
Demo is not for Amiga, but uses Amiga mod for its music.
Art from the demo by Acryl.

A1200 r1D.4 audio. ProTracker 2.3F (8bitbubsy). Dolby Headphone DSP effect applied.
title: Amiga music: Jazz - Modulator demo OST (A1200🎧Dolbyfied)

"Rubbur" demo OST by Steffest, demo ranked 1st at RSYNC 2026 oldskool demo compo.
Art from the demo by Steffest.

Still image is using CRT emulation. John Novak's WinUAE setup guide here:
https://bit.ly/4rojuio

A1200 r1D.4 audio. ProTracker 2.3F (8bitbubsy). Dolby Headphone DSP effect applied.
title: Amiga music: Steffest - Rubbur demo OST (A1200🎧Dolbyfied)
